description.value: Le Coq Frit is a Korean-influenced fried chicken eatery with a North Vancouver outpost at Lonsdale Quay, serving hand-battered chicken in several styles—honey garlic soy, Nashville hot, sweet & spicy, and a double-fried 'real crispy' version—alongside chicken burgers on French brioche buns. The restaurant sources ingredients locally from Canadian farms and has committed to zero-waste, eco-friendly non-woven bag packaging. It is one of two Greater Vancouver locations, with menus available in multiple languages including Korean, French, and Chinese.
